column1: # This CSV file is a placeholder for Schwab-formatted trades.
# ChatGPT will generate filled versions of this file when you upload
# your Positions CSV and Transactions CSV into the project.
# - Account: Your Schwab account number (placeholder 1122-3344 by default)
# - Trades are kept Mariner-style (one-for-one pairing of stock sells with ETF buys
#   and ETF sells with stock buys).
# - Do not aggregate ETF orders; each is listed separately for tax accounting clarity.
# - This file can be uploaded directly into Schwab once populated with real orders.
